atoms.text: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben to buy, to know, to eat und to write kennen.
atoms.sound: Im Folgenden lernst du die unregelmäßigen Verben <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to buy, to know, to eat</voice> und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>to write</voice> kennen.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to buy in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to buy</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: Today I want to buy orange juice.
atoms.b: Today I want to ((buy)) orange juice.

atoms.sound: I have never bought carrot juice.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to know in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to know</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: She knows how to dive now.
Her parents knew that she wanted to learn how to dive last summer.
atoms.b: Her parents ((knew)) that she wanted to learn how to dive last summer.

atoms.sound: But she has known how to swim since she was 7 years old.
atoms.b: But she has ((known)) how to swim since she was 7 years old.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to eat in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to eat</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: At dinner, we will eat spaghetti bolognese.
atoms.b: At dinner, we will ((eat)) spaghetti bolognese.

atoms.sound: Recently, we have often eaten burgers at dinner.
atoms.b: Recently, we have often ((eaten)) burgers at dinner.

instruction.text: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs to write in den folgenden Sätzen.
instruction.sound: Tippe auf die Formen des Verbs <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>to write</voice> in den folgenden Sätzen.

atoms.sound: He wants to write a book.
He wrote short stories in the past.
atoms.b: He ((wrote)) short stories in the past.

atoms.sound: But he has never written a book.
atoms.b: But he has never ((written)) a book.
